sections.title: Reading and updating user profiles
sections.what: The lookup returns a user's profile or raises a not-found error. The update saves the given changes and returns the profile, always without the password hash.
sections.why: Likely reason: the password hash is removed in both places so it is never sent to the app.
sections.watch_out: The update takes any object and writes it straight to the database. Keep input checks in the controller or add a field list here.

summary: Reads and updates user records in the database, and removes the password hash before returning anything.
purpose: Provides the profile lookup and profile update work for the user feature.
why: Likely reason: keeps the password hash from ever leaving the server. Otherwise reason not stated.
how: The find function looks up a user by id, raises a not-found error if none exists, and returns the profile without the hash. The update function writes the given data to the user and returns the profile without the hash.
inputs: A user id, and for updates a data object (normally the validated profile fields).
outputs: An object with the profile under a data field, never including the password hash.
risks: The update function accepts any object and passes it to the database without a field list, so extra fields can be written if a caller skips validation. Errors from the update, such as a missing user, are not handled here.
debug: A 'User not found' response means the id does not match a record. Database errors from updates should be checked against the user table and the data sent. Check the controller for what was validated.
